Dragon Ball Super's unusual production history (much of its story originates from Toriyama's own movie scripts and outlines adapted into anime before or alongside Toyotaro's manga, rather than the more typical anime-trails-manga pattern) means the canon/filler line here is fan-consensus-driven rather than a strict manga-publication-order check — consistent with how this project's other shows are compiled, but worth flagging given how different this show's production actually was.
